about: Batch 6 PR2 (fix/batch6b): the output changes made on purpose, compared with 5dcd0a2 by `bash scripts/golden-check.sh 5dcd0a2 full --expect tests/golden_expect/batch6b.json --items kl3`. Only KL3's MASK_VERSION 7 -> 8 shows: B5 and B6 change nothing in the golden boxes (no gitleaks hits, key blocks or dismissals there), and KL6 needs a kept roll-call answer the boxes don't have.

entries.why: MASK_VERSION 7 -> 8 (KL3, #15 medium 6): the marker says every approved copy was masked again by version 8
MASK_VERSION 7 -> 8: each approved copy is re-masked and records version 8; the copy is parsed and must be exactly the same apart from that field (no copy's text may change)
MASK_VERSION 7 -> 8: engine cache entries are re-masked and record version 8
